title: Most convenient humidifier we've ever used, and your table won't get wet...
text:
Most convenient humidifier we've ever used, and your table won't get wet.... [[VIDEOID:2b05528a37d71e5118294f57a696be93]] SEPTEMBER 9, 2022 UPDATE:
-----------------------------------
* We've gone through many humidifiers in our life. This is the first one to ever develop mold on us. Scare the heck outta me because it's in our daughter's room, thank goodness nobody got sick. It is a hassle to clean this thing, there are so many components, including over 40 plates you'd have to clean. This thing has been in use every night, so it wasn't as if we left water inside unused. Our maintenance routine and habits have not change, but this is the first one to ever get mold on us. Going back to our older model which actually shoots out mist and gets your table wet. We wanted a dry table in the morning, so we've been using this model, but not anymore. Going back to wet tables. LOL! Perhaps if you are will to work hard and maintain this machine properly, then it won't mold on you. But like I said, there are too many components to clean, it is a big inconvenience. Changing this to 2-Stars.

ORIGINAL REVIEW BELOW:
--------------------------------

THE GOOD:
--------------
* Your end table, even nonporous ones will stay dry.
* Convenient over the top refilling. We keep a gallon water bottle nearby. Much easier then the standard way of taking humidifiers to the sink.
* Water level indicator during refilling is very convenient.
* Connects to Alexa and our smart home easily via the Mi Home app.
* Very quiet.

THE BAD:
------------
* Nothing so far. I'm a little perplexed by some of the bad reviews. It may be because we are not picky with humidifiers. We've gone from those cheap cute animal looking ones by Vicks to bigger 4 to 5L ones, and now to this evaporative version. All throughout our history of using humidifiers, we've never bothered to compare or measure if the humidity level is accurate. I think if we did that, like many of the reviewers are talking about, then I guess we would be unhappy as well. But we've never had a case of feeling the room is not humid enough, so we don't check. I think it's one of those things where ignorance is bliss. If you want to be picky and compare levels and all that stuff, you'll end up not liking the majority of the humidifiers on the market. We would know if it's not working well, base on my daughter's nose. She needs a humid room, or her nose gets really dry and uncomfy. So far, this Smartmi is working fine for her. 5-Stars.

Automatic & Long-lasting Comfort : Auto mode can automatically adjust evaporation rate to maintain comfortable humidity levels. Simply set it and forget about it. Easy App Remote Control: Compatible with Mi Home and Xiaomi Home App, the smartmi cool no mist humidifier can be set from anywhere at any time.
